column1: # Facts about plants, restated in our own words. A fact is not copyrighted; only wording and the
# database as a whole are. One row per fact; the source is cited, never copied. Columns, tab-separated:
# evidence: handbook | single_study | several_studies | review | regulatory  (how well it is backed)

column4: About 30 % of the dried cone berries are free sugars, glucose and fructose (invert sugar), plus pectin. The content varies with origin and ripeness. The figure is a handbook value (Wichtl, Teedrogen, 1984) repeated by the EMA assessment reports; no targeted quantification by ripening stage was found. The EMA notes there is no consensus on the role of the sugars.
